body_lead: The AI-powered surveillance network has been installed along four key highway stretches — Manguli–Sambalpur, Sambalpur–Raipur, Berhampur–Bhanjanagar and Bhanjanagar–Taptapani Bhubaneswar: In a major push to strengthen road safety and enforce traffic discipline, the Odisha government has activated Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled surveillance cameras along four major national highway corridors. The system, which became operational on August 1, will automatically detect traffic violations and generate e-challans for offenders.
